note: Closed form: retained bytearray(BUFFER_SIZE) is PYMEM_DOMAIN_MEM on 3.13+. heap-space on allocate_mem_domain_buffer is BUFFER_SIZE (16777216). Weight can include unsampled bytes from the same Poisson window (tcmalloc-style C), so the stack can read slightly above 16 MiB. error_margin 20 is conservative and not sized from a capture. Default mem_domain (Dockerfile does not pin DD_PROFILING_MEMORY_MEM_DOMAIN_ENABLED). Combined upload profile (profiles.*.pprof). Single dump at shutdown so compare-gate-pair can include this family (live_heap is excluded because UPLOAD_INTERVAL produces multiple dumps).
